stem: What is the poet suggesting by referring to the speaker’s “invisible twin”?

options.label: F
options.text: The speaker has a sister living on the island whom she is looking forward to seeing.

options.label: G
options.text: The speaker feels a bond with the land, and she believes it will always be her homeland.

options.label: H
options.text: The speaker feels lonely on the island, and she wishes her family were there to share the experience with her.

options.label: J
options.text: The speaker looks forward to spending time with close friends while she visits her homeland.

visual_elements: It’s as if my other self has been here all along— the invisible twin who never left this island and never will.
